notes.title: Ball King Jam demo is live with local multiplayer for up to 4 players!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/448840/Ball_King_Jam/

We're happy to share our free demo for our upcoming game Ball King Jam with you. The game has local multiplayer for up to 4 players (co-op or PvP), so grab your friends/parters/kids and battel it out on the courts!

We also have a new gameplay trailer below!

[previewyoutube=7VH0925gM50;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ball King Jam | Announcement
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/448840/Ball_King_Jam/

We're excited to announce our new game! Ball King Jam is silly physics-based basketball game. Play agains computer opponents or enjoy beating your friends in various environments and courts.

This is not your usual 'boring' basketball! In our game you will be using the environment to outsmart your opponents and pull off your best dunks! You can play against the AI on your own or have freinds help you in a co-op game. Or to spice things up play against your friends in PvP game.

To learn more about the game and to keep up to date on the development please make sure to wishlist the game and follow!

Check out the announcement trailer below!

[previewyoutube=U6EoxZWLh1Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 1.6 brings Halloween costumes!
notes.notes:
This update brings you two new costumes so you can dress up for Halloween!

Which one will you choose, zombie or skeleton?

Also added more shortcuts to the game, you can press your jump key to confirm  buttons (default jump key is space), so you don't need to reach for your mouse just to press "play again" button and so on. Also use Esc key to navigate back through menus or to pause/unpause the game.

notes.title: Update 1.5 adding Exit button was released.
notes.notes:

Thanks a lot for all your support!
